A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CMO research and contain readable main texts, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Relocated and renumbered material can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original CMO evaluations on ConceptMix, GenEval 2, T2I-CompBench, and DrawBench, alongside ablations and training analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains original CMO benchmark results, ablations, image-quality evaluations, and training analyses.

M1.justification: The CMO optimization procedure is retained. The softmax attribute reward replacing main-text cosine similarity was already specified as the actual implementation in v1 Appendix C. Expanded template and global-style feature handling documents implementation details rather than establishing a new algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same single-attribute and multi-concept training coverage and evaluate ConceptMix, GenEval 2, T2I-CompBench, and DrawBench. ConceptMix complexity levels k=1–7 remain covered.

E2.justification: v2 removes DALL-E 2 from the T2I-CompBench comparison in Table 4. DALL-E 3 and the other comparators remain; comparator membership in the other matched experiments is unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported ablation metrics drop the Hard aggregation over k=5–7 from v1 Table 5. v2 reports overall Full Mark and Concept Fraction scores, already present in v1 Table 8. Training settings, evaluators, and other evaluation procedures remain unchanged; this does not establish a rerun.

E4.justification: The component analysis specifically summarizing performance on the hardest prompts is removed. The expanded DRO/data/correlation ablation moves unchanged from v1 Appendix B and Table 8 into v2 Section 4.3 and Table 5. Hyperparameter, group-size, training-efficiency, and complexity analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report ten images with different seeds per prompt for the main benchmarks and five seeds for DrawBench. No changes to repeated-run information, uncertainty estimation, confidence intervals, or significance testing are reported.

E6.justification: v2 removes the DALL-E 2 results from Table 4, including its 0.4355 average, and the hard-subset ablation scores 0.0838, 0.1176, 0.1449, and 0.1755. Matched surviving scores and plotted findings are unchanged; v2 Table 5 reproduces results already in v1 Table 8.

T1.justification: The optimization objectives, correlation definitions, and spatial-reward mathematics are retained. v2 restates the existing appendix softmax reward in the main text and explicitly writes out previously described template averaging and normalization. No substantive new assumptions, derivations, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about correlation-based reward weighting, simultaneous concept satisfaction, backbone applicability, and benchmark performance.

C2.justification: New Section 5 discusses adapting fixed concept-sampling ratios to observed failures, incorporating perceptual-quality constraints, and investigating dependence on pretraining scale. These are specific future directions; existing interpretations of concept conflicts, training instability, and image-quality trade-offs remain.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability link and expands reward implementation documentation with template examples, explicit averaging and L2 normalization, and whole-image features for global style. Training hyperparameters and resource information are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds the GPT-4o system-card reference and removes the DALL-E 2 reference accompanying its deleted comparison row. The broader positioning relative to compositional generation and diffusion reinforcement learning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized reward explanations are rewritten, the extended appendix ablation is moved into the main text, and discussion and acknowledgements sections are added. Appendices are reordered and relabeled, while most prose and the overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 5 adopts the structure of v1 Table 8, Table 4 loses one row, and appendix displays are relocated and renumbered. Figure 2 receives notation edits, and headers and spacing change. The plotted results and qualitative image examples are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 makes the main reward description consistent with the implementation already documented in v1's appendix and adds useful feature-construction details and a code-access pointer. These modestly improve clarity and reproducibility guidance. Removing hard-subset ablation summaries reduces diagnostic detail, but the principal comparisons and analyses remain intact.
